products.usage_instructions:
1. Take 2 cups of Masala Diabetic Roti Powder in a bowl
  2. Add warm water gradually and knead into a soft dough
  3. Let the dough rest for 10-15 minutes
  4. Divide into equal-sized balls
  5. Roll out into thin rotis using a rolling pin
  6. Cook on a hot tawa (griddle) until golden brown spots appear on both sides
  7. Drizzle with ghee and serve hot

Tip: For best results, consume within 15 minutes of cooking. Pairs well with yogurt, pickles, or any curry.
products.storage_instructions: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, transfer to an airtight container and consume within 30 days. Refrigerate for extended freshness up to 60 days.

Masala Diabetic Roti Powder – Low GI Healthy Roti Mix for Diabetic Diet, Weight Management & Balanced Everyday Nutrition

Struggling to find a healthy roti alternative that supports blood sugar control without sacrificing traditional desi taste? Masala Diabetic Roti Powder is specially formulated for people looking for a smarter, fiber-rich, low glycemic food option for breakfast, lunch, dinner, sehri, or light healthy meals.

Made with nutrient-dense ingredients like quinoa powder, besan, daal mong powder, flex seeds, dehydrated vegetables, and flavorful masala seasoning, this diabetic-friendly roti mix helps you enjoy soft, savory rotis while supporting a healthier lifestyle.

Available Sizes

  • 1 KG Pack – Ideal for personal use, small families, and first-time buyers
  • 2 KG Pack – Best value option for regular use, larger families, and long-term healthy meal planning

Healthy Alternative to Regular Flour & High-Carb Rotis

Many traditional flours and processed roti mixes may cause sudden energy crashes or unwanted sugar spikes after meals. Masala Diabetic Roti Powder is crafted with a Low Glycemic Index (GI) ingredient profile to support steadier energy release and more balanced eating habits throughout the day.

Key Benefits of Masala Diabetic Roti Powder

  • Low Glycemic Index (GI) formula for balanced eating
  • Supports healthy blood sugar management
  • Rich source of dietary fiber for digestive support
  • Good source of plant-based protein
  • Helps support weight management goals
  • Gluten-free and easy to digest
  • Suitable for healthy breakfast, lunch, dinner, or sehri meals
  • Quick and convenient to prepare at home

Made using the traditional bilona (churning) method. Milk cream is churned to extract butter, then slow-cooked to produce golden, aromatic ghee. No additives, preservatives, or artificial flavors.
products.usage_instructions:
• Cooking: Use 1-2 tablespoons for sautéing, frying, or tempering
  • Baking: Substitute for butter at a 1:1 ratio in recipes
  • Roti/Naan: Brush freshly cooked bread with ghee for authentic flavor
  • Rice: Add a teaspoon to steamed rice for aroma and taste
  • Hot Beverages: Add a small amount to tea or coffee for richness
products.storage_instructions: Store at room temperature in a cool, dry place. Ghee has a long shelf life of 12+ months without refrigeration. Use a clean, dry spoon每次 to prevent contamination. Do not introduce water into the container.

products.usage_instructions:
1. Take 100g of fry mix masala in a plate
  2. Add 1 tablespoon of oil and mix well to create a crumbly texture
  3. Marinate chicken, fish, or paneer with ginger-garlic paste and lemon juice
  4. Coat the marinated pieces evenly with the fry mix
  5. Let it rest for 15-20 minutes for the coating to set
  6. Deep fry in hot oil (180°C) until golden brown and crispy
  7. Drain on paper towels and serve hot

Tip: For extra crispiness, double-coat by dipping in batter and applying fry mix twice.
